risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.summary: The company is exposed to cybersecurity threats and information system disruptions, which could have severe consequences on its operations and customers.
risks.score_rationale: The company relies heavily on its information and technology systems for logistics operations, making it vulnerable to cyberattacks and disruptions of critical systems. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Competition
risks.summary: The company faces increasing competition in the logistics services market, which could affect its revenues and profitability.
